admuffs · v0.17.0

The web remote, screen by screen

admuffs serves a phone-friendly remote and control panel on your local network (default http://<pi>:8995). These are the actual interface screens, rendered from the app’s own markup with example data for an LG TV controlled over the network. Below each one is what it does and when you’d use it.

Port 8995 PIN-protected Mobile-first layout API + IR control 9 screens
Screens shown with representative data (LG C2 over webOS, duck mode, optional pHAT sensors populated). On your Pi the status line, config values, sensor rows, and log reflect your real hardware. Reach the remote at http://<your-pi-ip>:8995 from any device on the same network; the default PIN is 0000.
